interpretation: REA reconstructed an inert, AST-derived application graph of the four JS bridge files.
Zero findings/modules reported by REA reflect that these bridges are plain scripts, not a bundled CommonJS/ESM module graph.
The 3.6 MB Metro bundle (main.jsbundle) is analysed separately in jsbundle.json.
limitations_reported_by_REA: CommonJS and ESM binding relationships were recovered from inert syntax and resolved only within the inventoried artifact container.
JavaScript and HTML were parsed as inert text; bundle bootstrap code was never executed.
Static imports, entrypoints, workers, endpoints, and storage relationships do not prove runtime execution.
Static paths and relationships may remain unresolved when expressions are dynamic or obfuscated.
Webpack/Rspack factories were recovered from AST literals; REA did not invoke push handlers or bundle bootstrap code.
